blocks.x: Computer Vision & Edge AI is the IoT, Twin & Robotics answer to a specific job: Cameras into instruments — inspection, safety and counting at the edge, inside policy.. This page is the build as we actually run it — sequencing, artifacts and the parts most vendors leave out.
What we deliver under this name

Cameras are already everywhere; intelligence makes them instruments. We deliver vision systems for quality inspection (surface defects, welds, assembly completeness), safety compliance (PPE, zone intrusion, lockout-tagout verification), process reading (gauges, levels, counters) and logistics flows (damage, load verification) — engineered for the edge: GPU/accelerator inference on plant hardware, sub-second loop closure into PLCs and andon systems, and store-and-forward retraining pipelines for the rare classes.

Deployment discipline covers the unglamorous failure causes: lighting and lens design for the actual environment, camera calibration schedules, class-imbalance handling for rare defects, out-of-distribution monitoring, and privacy governance — face blurring, retention policy and works-council alignment where personnel are in frame. Autonomy tightens gradually: shadow mode first, human-verified second, closed-loop actuation only after measured error earns it.

Computer Vision & Edge AI delivery today concentrates in Manufacturing & Industrial, Logistics & Supply Chain, Retail & Consumer Goods, Energy & Utilities. The metric is chosen with your finance lead, and the baseline is signed before any build begins.
